teaser: Sawdust and machine oil, a hum of fluorescent light down a narrow aisle — that is the kind of room a 4 feels steady in, and you are a 4 who is also an ENFJ, which is an odd pairing to find standing there. A finished, load-bearing thing pulls at you from one side; a room full of people, lifted and understood, pulls from the other. You build the shelf and then notice who needs a hand carrying it. The crossing is not a contradiction so much as two different reasons for showing up early.
